changes.before: Gamma-delta T cell therapy uses a rare T-cell type that recognises stressed cancer cells without tissue matching, making it a candidate for off-the-shelf products.
changes.after: This therapy uses a type of T cell called gamma-delta. Different cells and added receptors can recognise different targets. Each product needs its own checks for matching, safety and benefit.
